name: Be Mine, Valentine
source:
Even after countless awful dates, you're still a romantic. Then, at the worst date of your life, Jamie shows up.

He/She turns disaster into a perfect night. The issue? You didn’t get a number or a last name.
translation:
即使经历了无数次糟糕的约会，你仍然是一个浪漫的人。然后，在你一生中最糟糕的约会中，杰米出现了。

他/她将灾难变成完美的夜晚。问题是什么？你没有得到电话号码或姓氏。
